question: What gallery are present within 180 kilometers while traveling from 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY toward Pier 55, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.009164 40.742448)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography, 180000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979628 40.74986)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
